body.text: Goals: Teach the man behind the metal mask. Play KMD → then DOOM. “How does someone’s pain change their voice?”

items: early career as Zev Love X in KMD
conscious, playful group with political edge
brother DJ Subroc dies in car accident
Dumile becomes homeless, disappears from the scene
returns years later with MASK + new identity → MF DOOM

finalProject.prompt: Explain how MF DOOM used persona, abstract lyricism, and unconventional production to reshape underground hip-hop. Compare ONE early track (‘Doomsday’) with ONE Madvillainy track (‘All Caps’ or ‘Accordion’), and identify TWO modern artists who clearly show DOOM’s influence in flow, imagery, or production style.
